en.topic_title: Tai Po fire: Former top official urges gov’t to publish building inspection report to clear buyout doubts
en.topic_summary:
A former top Hong Kong official has called on the government to release a structural inspection report of the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court to dispel the concerns of homeowners who have rejected the government’s apartment buyback offer.



Former secretary for transport and housing Anthony Cheung. File Photo: GovHK.
